message: When the storm rolls in and the power goes out, I find myself rediscovering the joys of low-tech fun. It’s amazing how a simple deck of cards or a good old-fashioned board game can bring a family together, isn’t it? Plus, it’s a great opportunity to share some stories, preferably the ones that don’t involve my questionable dance moves. What’s your favorite way to pass the time when the weather keeps you inside? ☔️
